استهجنت (form X)
# اِسْتَهْجَنْتُ (istahjantu) /is.tah.d͡ʒan.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# اِسْتَهْجَنْتَ (istahjanta) /is.tah.d͡ʒan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# اِسْتَهْجَنْتِ (istahjanti) /is.tah.d͡ʒan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# اِسْتَهْجَنَتْ (istahjanat)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
